cost.note: The official service sheet names Compounding Fee but gives no amount or rate; the reviewed service-sheet route is recorded in searchedRoutes.

documents.note: Schedule VIII, current Khata certificate and extract, tax-paid receipt, as-built drawings, and photographs are named for enclosure; CFO/KSPCB and Fire Clearance are conditional where applicable.

eligibility.note: The published rule applies to a property owner in BBMP jurisdiction who has obtained plan sanction.

time.note: The service sheet gives a maximum of 30 working days for service delivery; the BPAS FAQ separately says Part/Full OCC/BCC is granted within 7 working days after application when required documents are submitted and work is as approved.

owner.note: The actionable route is the Town Planning Section, Head Office, BBMP, with the Additional Director of Town Planning named under the Commissioner.

after-submission.note: The published procedure identifies a demand note to the party and certificate issuance; BPAS materials additionally describe authenticated proposal-flow/status and certificate-output surfaces that were not live-tested.
